name: issue_ref
description: GitHub issues and pull requests this record corresponds to, in owner-relative short form.

aiGuidance.purpose: Ties a programme record back to the tracker where the work is actually executed and discussed, so the record is not a second, drifting copy of the issue. A list because one unit routinely spans an issue, its epic and the PR that lands it.
aiGuidance.extraction: Write each reference in short form as repo#number — srs#557, srs-rust#874, srs-vscode#89 — one entry per reference, most specific first. Convert any full GitHub URL to short form. Include the epic or parent issue when the source names one.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not include bare numbers without a repository prefix; three repositories share this programme and #557 alone is ambiguous.
